note: TRIGGER-WORD A/B (W, 2026-08-18). Two prompts, identical seed, differing only in the spelling of Kim's project name. Training captions carry 'aavepyörä' 4724-7140x and 'aavepyora' 0x, yet every eval we have run used the latter -- so every trigger cell on the board asked a finetuned model for a token it never saw. This is the control that settles whether the finetunes learned it. Run against an AVP model: suomisoundi captions contain the trigger 0 times, so those arms cannot answer it.
